title: About
html:
Welcome to the Udaipur Cycling Club, or UCC, the biggest and most active cycling club in Udaipur. Founded in 2017, we are a community of passionate cyclists who share a love for exploring the beautiful landscapes and challenging terrains of Udaipur and beyond. With over 100+ privileged members, we are proud to have become a well-established and highly respected cycling club in our city.

At UCC, we believe that cycling is not just a form of exercise or recreation, but a way of life. Our members come from all walks of life, ages, and backgrounds, and are united by a common passion for cycling. Whether you are an experienced cyclist looking to improve your performance, or a beginner looking to enjoy the fresh air and stunning scenery of Udaipur, our club has something for everyone.

Vision: Our vision at UCC is to make Udaipur a cycling-friendly city, and to promote cycling as a popular and sustainable mode of transportation and recreation. We are committed to raising awareness about the health and environmental benefits of cycling, and to creating a supportive community of cyclists who can work together to achieve our vision.

To achieve our goals, we organize daily group rides that explore the scenic and challenging roads of Udaipur and the surrounding areas. Our rides vary in distance and difficulty and are designed to challenge our members while also providing an opportunity to socialize and have fun. We also organize long-distance expeditions to destinations across India, including the Statue of Unity, Tour de Jaisalmer, Tour de Diu, Mount Abu, Jodhpur, Jawai Dam, and Kota.

In addition to our regular rides, we also organize yearly events such as the Udaipur Duathlon, CycloRun, TAAVDO Challenge, and Holi Special ride. These events not only provide a fun and challenging experience for our members, but also help to raise awareness about the benefits of cycling and promote our vision of making Udaipur a cycling-friendly city.

We also publish a monthly newsletter and leaderboard, which showcases the achievements and progress of our members and keeps our community informed about upcoming events and activities.

At UCC, we believe that cycling is more than just a sport or a hobby – it is a way of life that can bring people together, promote health and sustainability, and create a sense of community. We invite you to join us on our journey to make Udaipur the biggest cycling city in India, and to experience the joy and camaraderie of cycling with our vibrant and welcoming community.
